$comment: Story 6.36a (`2026-10-14-330` SW4–SW9) — WHERE EACH MEMBER WORKS: the signup step (between KYC and nominees) and Life Events → Workplace. The member picks a district, then a school or an office from the list (or says their workplace isn't listed, or that they have retired), and the date they started there. ⛔ The workplace is NEVER shown publicly, in the member directory, or in any text message (I1). ⛔ No key here names a death, a claim or the people asked about one — this surface only records where the member works. 'Pariwar Admin' = 'परिवार एडमिन' (the house term). The Hindi is agent-authored and NOT YET HUMAN-REVIEWED — go-live Row 31 (f).
